payload.name: Compress JPG to 200KB by PrintableTools Lab
payload.short_description: Free no-signup JPG 200KB compressor with an optional one-contact USD 9 upload fix-plan request.
payload.long_description: A free browser-based JPG compressor for 200KB portal, marketplace, profile, and application upload limits. It works without an account or server upload and exposes a one-contact optional USD 9 Upload Limit Fix Plan request for exact public-safe settings, fallback steps, and a review-before-upload checklist after fit is confirmed.
